articles.title: Het geheime talent van Alexander 'Rain Man' Blockx: "Hij kent de uitslag nog van al zijn tennismatchen ooit"
articles.snippet: De eerste Belgische man ooit in de kwartfinale van de US Open heeft meer dan sportieve talenten. "Alexander herinnert zich elke wedstrijd die hij ooit speelde, inclusief de exacte score. Bovendien klopt die ook altijd", zegt zijn begeleider Tom Devries van Tennis Vlaanderen aan VRT NWS. Hij schetst ook het beeld van de familie achter de toptennisser.

articles.title: OpenAI models went rogue. We urgently need a better ‘hugging face’ investigation | Mackenzie Arnold and Stephan Llerena
articles.snippet: The breach won’t be the last – or the most dangerous – of its kind. We need an agency capable of full investigations into AI incidents When OpenAI first revealed that its AI agents had autonomously hacked a major real-world company, Hugging Face, many assumed only one or two agents were involved. The truth, a new report reveals, is far stranger: the incident involved about 1,200 AI agents, 700 of which directly participated in the attack. OpenAI invited researchers from METR, along with an expert from Redwood Research, to produce the new report, alongside the company’s own investigation . The findings shocked the experts.
